scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run --filter @moneyhound/web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.check: bun fmt --check --no-script && oxlint . && bun run typecheck && bun test packages apps
scripts.verify:formal: bun test packages/core/src/invariants && cd verification/lean && lake build
